title: Random Base62 codes from secrets, 7 characters by default
context: Issue asks for URL-safe Base62 codes of 7-8 characters with collision handling.
options: Encode the auto-increment id in Base62: no collisions, but sequential codes are guessable and leak volume
Hash the URL: deterministic, but the same URL must map to different codes (duplicates allowed in #3)
Random Base62 via secrets.choice: unguessable, needs a collision check
why: Unguessable codes stop people enumerating others' links. 62^7 is about 3.5 trillion codes, so collisions stay rare well past millions of links; length is configurable if we want 8.

title: Check code_exists before insert, and also retry on a unique-index violation, up to 5 attempts
context: Issue asks to check for collisions before persisting and retry on collision.
options: Pre-check only: matches the issue text but races with concurrent inserts
Insert-and-catch only: race-free, but skips the explicit check the issue asks for
Both: pre-check skips known-taken codes cheaply; the DuplicateShortCodeError from D5 covers the race
choice: Pre-check plus catch, max 5 attempts then CodeGenerationError
why: Satisfies the issue literally and stays correct under concurrency. With random 7-char codes, needing even a second attempt is vanishingly rare, so 5 is a safety stop, not a tuning knob.

title: Custom aliases: 3-32 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_-], reserved words blocked, no retry when taken
context: Issue asks for a separate validation path for user-supplied aliases.
options: Restrict aliases to Base62 like generated codes: simplest, but users expect hyphens
Allow letters, digits, '-' and '_' (all URL-safe unreserved chars), 3-32 long, and block names that would shadow routes like /api
choice: [A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,32} plus a reserved list; a taken alias raises AliasTakenError
why: Hyphenated aliases are the common case. The reserved list stops an alias like 'api' hijacking the endpoint path from #3, matched case-insensitively. A taken alias is an error the user must resolve, not something to retry silently.
